name: run_state_dispatch_loop
description: Loops over a switch on a state value, calling routines with offsets taken from the frame and running a common cleanup that calls two jump-table entries through a context pointer. The routine calls and exit path are the only evidence of what it does.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:ultima6:1:0132
name: resume_state_dispatch_loop
description: Enters the same state dispatch loop partway in: if a flag bit in a context record is clear it calls a routine and reads its result, otherwise it sets the exit state, then runs the shared cleanup that calls two jump-table entries and returns.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:ultima6:1:0142
name: run_dispatch_exit_cleanup
description: Calls one routine with frame-relative arguments, then runs the shared cleanup tail, which invokes jump-table entries through a context pointer and returns.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:ultima6:1:014C
name: run_requester_dispatch_loop
description: Runs the state dispatch loop with a requester-style routine call that chooses between two text pointers by a flag, then runs the shared cleanup. The Amiga library calls in the routine are the close, requester and Workbench-open functions.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:ultima6:1:04F8
name: set_copper_list_pointer
description: Stores a pointer into a global variable and returns the value of the copper list location register, which the callee reads to start the new list.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:ultima6:1:04FE
name: forward_stack_args_to_routine
description: Scans stack arguments up to a zero terminator, then passes the two entries after it on to another routine as its arguments.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:ultima6:1:0504
name: clear_result_through_pointer
description: Clears a 16-bit result field in a context structure, saves the parameter as a pointer, calls a routine with a stack address, then writes a zero byte through the saved pointer and returns the field.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:ultima6:1:050A
name: wait_for_matching_record
description: Repeatedly fetches a record through a library call and calls a wait routine until a record has zero in two fields and a value matching a stored key, then returns that record's long field at a later offset.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:ultima6:4:0000
name: split_command_text_into_tokens
description: Splits a text buffer into tokens separated by spaces, tabs or newlines, storing a pointer to each token in a table. Quoted tokens are copied with asterisk escapes turned into characters, with the E escape becoming a control code and N becoming a newline, and the routine stops once the table is full.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:ultima6:4:010C
name: wait_for_timer_expiry
description: Fills three stack buffers through routine calls, optionally runs one routine, then polls a timer device in a loop until the time value passes a fixed threshold, with a second threshold check as a fallback.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:ultima6:4:0112
name: process_flagged_table_entries
description: Walks a table of six-byte records backward from a stored count, and for each record whose low byte is non-zero and whose fifth flag bit is clear, calls a routine on it. It then calls one more routine.

name: handle_task_port_message
description: Finds the calling task, waits for a message on its port, takes the message and records its payload in globals, then replies to the message. It also installs a handler address and calls a routine through a table before returning.

name: update_global_params
description: Stores its first parameter and a register value into globals, clears a flag global, then calls two routines through jump-table entries of the second parameter.

name: run_setup_routines_then_jump
description: Saves its own address into a global, calls three setup routines from a table pointed to by its parameter, then jumps through a vector held in a global.

name: open_dos_library_and_dispatch
description: Opens dos.library through the exec library table, calls one library function and, if it succeeds, calls another. It then calls a further library function and dispatches through a table entry when that returns non-zero.

name: dispatch_on_matching_tag
description: Compares two stored tag words in a table indexed by a register value against two fixed tag constants, returns if neither matches, and otherwise calls a routine through a table entry.

name: save_pointer_and_set_self
description: Copies the current value of one global into a second global and stores its own address into the first, then returns.

name: set_cia_bit_around_call
description: Sets bit 6 of a global flag byte that mirrors the CIA A control register, calls one routine, clears that bit again and returns the register value it was given.

name: spin_forever_idle_loop
description: Contains only an empty loop with no exit, so execution parks here forever; it does no work and calls nothing in its decompiled body.

name: store_pointer_fields_then_call
description: Writes one computed address value into two fixed fields of a structure, calls a routine, then makes an indirect call through the structure's first table entry.

name: dispatch_unresolved_indirect_call
description: Makes an indirect call through a pointer the decompiler could not resolve, so the callee is unknown from this code alone.

name: read_global_with_bits_cleared
description: Returns a global word with bits four to six cleared, leaving the other bits unchanged.

name: store_stack_word_to_global
description: Copies a word argument passed on the stack into a global variable and returns.

name: return_zero_constant
description: Returns the constant zero with no other effect, so callers always receive a zero result.

name: set_record_flag_bit_one
description: Sets bit one of the byte at offset fourteen in the structure whose pointer is passed in an address register.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Does nothing and returns immediately; the decompiled body is empty, so no behaviour can be recovered.

name: store_register_to_global
description: Copies the data register value it receives into a global variable and returns.

name: copy_global_then_jump_indirect
description: Copies one global value into a second global, then makes an indirect jump through a pointer the decompiler could not resolve.

name: copy_record_byte_to_table
description: Copies the byte at offset six of the record in an address register into a byte at a fixed offset from a second base register.

name: check_global_equals_constant
description: Returns four when a global variable equals a fixed constant, and one otherwise.

name: initialize_sentinel_list_links
description: Writes a minus-two sentinel into an entry, points the list head and two structure links at the next slot, writes the sentinel there too and clears a word field.

name: copy_nested_pointer_fields
description: If the pointers at offsets four and eight of the source structure are non-zero, copies the 32-bit value each one references into fixed fields of a destination structure.

name: fill_three_words_minus_one
description: Writes minus one into the first three 32-bit words of the structure pointed to by an address register.

name: convert_clock_fields_to_count
description: Combines three table values, dividing one by fifty, into a single count: the first value times 1440 times 60, plus the second times 60, plus the third over fifty, stored in a structure field. The constants suggest a day, minute and frame clock conversion.

name: check_disk_bit_and_report
description: Clears a status byte, then either calls a table routine when a type code is two, or tests one bit of a mask global. If that bit is set it writes a digit into a text buffer and calls a table routine; if clear it sets status 28. When the structure's flag bit is set it sets status 29 instead, and it returns the status byte.

name: negate_word_and_flip_flag
description: Negates a 16-bit value in one structure and flips the top bit of a byte in another, returning a non-zero value when that top bit was previously clear.

name: store_inverted_bit_test_mask
description: Tests one bit of a global flag byte, chosen by an index stored in a second structure, and writes 255 into a field if that bit is clear or zero if it is set.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Does nothing and returns immediately; the decompiled body is empty, so no behaviour can be recovered.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Does nothing and returns immediately; the decompiled body is empty, so no behaviour can be recovered.

name: consume_pending_bit_and_signal
description: Clears one bit of a pending-event bitmask chosen by an index in a structure. If that bit was set, it marks a status flag, bumps a counter, calls a routine when the flag was newly set, clears the flag and bumps the counter again.

name: store_byte_and_set_bit
description: Disables interrupts through the exec kernel, obtains an index from a routine, stores a byte at that index in a buffer, sets the matching bit in the buffer's first byte, then re-enables the kernel.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Does nothing and returns immediately; the decompiled body is empty, so no behaviour can be recovered.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Does nothing and returns immediately; the decompiled body is empty, so no behaviour can be recovered.

name: clear_field_and_save_pointer
description: Writes zero into the field at offset twelve of the structure passed in one address register, saves another register value into a global, then returns.

name: compare_state_then_dispatch
description: Compares a register value with a saved global; when they differ it makes an indirect call through a table entry, otherwise it calls a routine and then makes that same indirect call.

name: compare_state_then_dispatch
description: Compares a register value with a saved global; when they differ it makes an indirect call through a table entry, otherwise it calls a routine and then makes that same indirect call.

name: store_own_address_in_global
description: Stores the address of a routine into a global pointer and returns.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Contains only a bad-instruction marker, so the decompiler could not recover any logic; it is a stub with no behaviour.

name: allocate_and_enqueue_library_node
description: Allocates a node through exec and sets a flag and two constant fields, opens expansion.library, allocates a second structure linked back to the first, and adds it to a list with the exec enqueue call.

name: allocate_and_init_struct
description: Allocates a block through exec, stores a shifted form of its address in a structure field, then writes zero and two constants into its first words and zero into the fourth.

name: call_through_resolved_vector
description: Writes a word back to the address it was given, calls a routine through a structure table entry, then makes an indirect call through the entry that routine returned.

name: call_dos_library_function
description: Calls a table routine to obtain a library structure for dos.library, then makes an indirect call through a fixed offset in that structure.

name: send_dos_request_message
description: Finds the current task, opens dos.library by name, builds a request message on the stack, sends it to the task's port, then waits for the reply and dispatches to the handler whose key matches the reply.

name: dispatch_reply_by_key_table
description: Makes three library port calls to fetch a reply, then scans a table of key and offset pairs for the key stored in the message and calls the handler at the matching offset.

name: set_status_and_dispatch
description: Sets a status field to minus one, stores a second register value, sends and waits on the port, then dispatches the handler whose key matches the message.

name: copy_buffered_bytes_with_refill
description: Copies a block of bytes from a source buffer into a destination, limited by the bytes remaining. When the source region is exhausted it refills it through a routine and copies from a second buffer, updates the position and count fields, then dispatches the follow-up handler by key.

name: write_buffered_bytes_with_growth
description: Writes bytes into a buffer while tracking the logical position and the highest position reached, allocating a new block through exec when none is held, then dispatches the follow-up handler by key.

name: copy_field_and_dispatch_reply
description: Calls a table routine, copies a field into the result slot, stores a register value into a second slot, then sends and waits on the port and dispatches the handler matching the reply key.

name: store_result_and_dispatch
description: Stores a returned value in a result field, or minus one if the high half of the result is non-zero, then sends and waits on the port and dispatches the handler whose key matches the reply.

name: store_result_and_dispatch
description: Stores a returned value in a result field, or minus one if the high half of the result is non-zero, then sends and waits on the port and dispatches the handler whose key matches the reply.

name: send_status_and_dispatch_reply
description: Calls routines and, when a result has a non-zero high half, calls a library routine and a second routine, choosing a status of zero or minus one. It then stores the value and status, sends and waits on the port, and dispatches the handler matching the reply.

name: send_minus_one_and_dispatch
description: Calls a table routine when a stored field is non-zero, then sets the status to minus one, sends and waits on the port, and dispatches the handler whose key matches the reply.

name: advance_position_with_limit_check
description: Computes a new position from a base field and an offset, using the base or the size field depending on a mode value. If the result passes the stored limit it sets the status to minus one and error code 219; otherwise it commits the new position. It then sends and waits on the port and dispatches the handler matching the reply.

name: advance_position_or_fail
description: Adds an offset to a position field, failing with minus one and error code 219 when the result passes the stored limit. It then sends and waits on the port and dispatches the handler matching the reply.

name: report_error_219_and_dispatch
description: Sets the error code to 219 and the status to minus one, sends and waits on the port, then dispatches the handler whose key matches the reply.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Does nothing and returns immediately; the decompiled body is empty, so no behaviour can be recovered.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Does nothing and returns immediately; the decompiled body is empty, so no behaviour can be recovered.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Does nothing and returns immediately; the decompiled body is empty, so no behaviour can be recovered.

name: rotate_string_and_store_length
description: Shifts the bytes of a zero-terminated string one place forward, carrying the first byte along, then writes a count byte just before the end, computed from the number of bytes shifted.

name: allocate_request_block_or_report
description: Calls a routine and returns zero if it fails. Otherwise it allocates a block through exec; on allocation failure it reports error 103 through a library routine, and if a second routine fails it reports error 205. On success it stores the values it was given in the block.

name: report_request_block_fields
description: When its argument is non-zero, passes a stored value and a second field to a library routine, calls the same routine again when the stored value is non-zero, then makes a final library call.

name: join_directory_and_file_name
description: Measures a directory string and a name, splits the name at its last colon, allocates a block through exec sized for the combined path, copies the directory, adds a slash, then copies the remaining name and terminates it. It returns the buffer with status zero, or error 103 if allocation fails.

name: call_routines_with_fallback
description: Calls one routine and, if it does not produce a result, calls a second one in a fallback sequence, returning zero when neither produces a value.

name: compare_two_strings
description: Compares two zero-terminated byte strings one byte at a time, returning as soon as they differ and returning normally once both reach the terminating zero.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Does nothing and returns immediately; the decompiled body is empty, so no behaviour can be recovered.

name: open_library_or_fallback
description: Records two values in globals, calls a routine, and runs a table routine when a flag bit is set. It then opens a library through the exec table and calls a fallback routine when the open fails, or a second routine when it succeeds.

name: open_library_or_fallback
description: Records two values in globals, calls a routine, and runs a table routine when a flag bit is set. It then opens a library through the exec table and calls a fallback routine when the open fails, or a second routine when it succeeds.

name: call_three_unnamed_routines
description: The decompiler timed out, so only the listing facts are known: this handler pointer routine makes calls to three other routines, and no further logic could be recovered.

name: copy_global_word
description: Copies one global 16-bit word into a second global 16-bit word and returns.

name: advance_pseudo_random_state
description: Multiplies a global 16-bit state word by 1453, adds 18269 and stores the result, then returns the high half of the product together with half of the new state, the shape of a pseudo-random generator step.

name: initialize_display_and_copper
description: Sets up the display at startup: calls many routines that allocate buffers through the memory call, fill tables with computed entries, write the copper list address and the DMA control word to enable channels, and load a graphics file. The referenced text includes a prompt to unwrite protect the disk and press a key.

name: check_library_versions_and_setup
description: Opens the exec and intuition libraries through library stubs, checks a version byte of the first library against the value two, and when a flag is set makes two more calls using the second library's fields.

name: call_two_routines
description: Calls two routines in sequence and returns, one of them a library function at a fixed offset.

name: store_two_global_parameters
description: Stores its two parameters into adjacent global variables, the second truncated to a word, and returns.

name: lookup_resource_and_report_status
description: Looks up a resource identified by its first argument. On failure it writes status 1 through the pointer it receives; later checks write status 2 or 3, and it returns a value from the routine calls.

name: call_two_unnamed_routines
description: The decompiler timed out, so only the listing facts are known: this routine makes calls to two other routines across 49 instructions, and no further logic could be recovered.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Does nothing and returns immediately; the decompiled body is empty, so no behaviour can be recovered.

name: run_dma_transfer_checked
description: Calls a transfer routine with a status out-pointer, writes the DMA control word that enables channels, and when the status is non-zero calls an error routine that reports a disk I/O error.

name: build_backpiece_table_entries
description: Adds a base offset to each record of a table of 24-byte entries up to a count, appends a record with a sentinel value of 1000, and when a flag argument is set calls a table-lookup routine. It reports an overflow message through the referenced text when the count exceeds a fixed limit.

name: load_config_and_init_tables
description: Calls routines to position a file read and enables DMA through the control word. When the load status is zero it writes two fixed table records; otherwise it loops ten times writing three records at a stride of twenty bytes. The referenced text names a configuration file.

name: toggle_flag_and_run_sequence
description: Inverts a flag byte in a structure, then runs one of two routine-call sequences: fixed constant arguments when a mode value is zero, or a second set using the base offset of the global.

name: run_mode_selected_setup_sequence
description: Runs one of two routine-call sequences chosen by a mode value, one using fixed constants and the other offsets from the global base, writing to a set of table entries through the routines.

name: run_mode_selected_setup_sequence
description: Runs one of two routine-call sequences chosen by a mode value, one using fixed constants and the other offsets from the global base, writing to a set of table entries through the routines.

name: run_mode_selected_setup_sequence
description: Runs one of two routine-call sequences chosen by a mode value, one using fixed constants and the other offsets from the global base, then enables DMA and writes a configuration table through the routines.

name: write_table_slot_constants
description: Writes a series of constant byte values into one slot of a table with a stride of ten, indexed from its parameter. Each write overwrites the previous one, so the final stored value is one.

name: run_dma_transfer_checked
description: Calls a transfer routine with a status out-pointer, writes the DMA control word that enables channels, and when the status is non-zero calls an error routine that reports a disk I/O error.

name: swap_two_adjacent_bytes
description: Exchanges the two bytes at the pointed-to address with the byte following them.

name: reverse_four_byte_block
description: Reverses the four bytes at the pointed-to address by exchanging the first with the last and the middle two with each other.

name: fill_bytes_with_value
description: Stores the low byte of its third argument into each of a count of consecutive bytes starting at the destination.

name: move_memory_block_overlap_safe
description: Copies a count of bytes from source to destination, copying forward when the source is below the destination and backward otherwise, so overlapping regions are handled correctly.

name: enable_dma_and_start_copper
description: When a flag is set it runs two routine calls, then stores a value into the copper list location pointer and writes a DMA control word that enables channels, and calls library and routines to start the display.

name: allocate_memory_or_report_error
description: Calls an allocation library routine with its two arguments and, if it returns zero, calls a reporting routine that shows the message that no more memory can be allocated, then returns the result.

name: call_three_subroutines
description: Calls one routine, then a second with its argument and the constant one, then the first routine again, and returns.

name: process_stack_buffer_params
description: Allocates a sixty-byte stack buffer, passes it to a routine together with each of its two parameters in turn, then calls the routine once more with the buffer alone.

name: clear_word_table
description: Sets each of the sixty-four words in a global word table to zero.

name: read_joystick_direction_and_fire
description: Increments a counter, then combines bits from an eight-entry key table, the fire-button register of CIA A and the mouse-port movement register into a 16-bit input status, which it returns.

name: read_and_clear_global_byte
description: Increments a global counter, calls a library routine, reads a global byte and clears it, calls the routine again, and returns the byte it read.

name: set_global_byte_from_argument
description: Stores the second byte of its argument into a global byte.

name: set_global_byte_return_old
description: Increments a global counter, calls a library routine, saves the previous value of a global byte and sets it to 127, calls the routine again, and returns the saved value.

name: set_global_word_from_argument
description: Stores the low 16 bits of its argument into a global word variable.

name: advance_counter_wait_for_limit
description: Increments a global counter, calls a routine, moves a second counter up to the limit if it has already reached it, then busy-waits until that counter reaches the limit and resets it to zero.

name: call_indirect_handler
description: Calls the routine whose address is stored in a global variable, then returns.

name: call_indirect_handler
description: Calls the routine whose address is stored in a global variable, then returns.

name: update_coordinate_table
description: Swaps two global values, then fills a global table with four pairs of 16-bit values, each a base plus a multiple of forty, storing the high and low words of each sum, and then calls routines and library routines.

name: wait_and_configure_blitter
description: Waits until the blitter is idle by polling its busy bit, then programs its first and last word masks, modulo, control and pointer registers, and size register from global values.

name: wait_and_setup_blitter
description: Waits until the blitter is idle by polling its busy bit, then programs its masks, modulo, control, pointer and size registers from global values, in a slightly different order.

name: save_and_enable_interrupt_bits
description: Saves the current value of a global into two save slots, writes an address into a global, then writes the interrupt enable control value with bit fifteen and bit four set.

name: poll_interrupt_request_registers
description: The decompiler timed out, so only the listing facts are known: this routine reads the interrupt request and enable registers and the vertical position register, and makes one call to another routine. No further logic could be recovered.

name: restore_saved_global
description: Copies a saved global variable back into the main global variable and returns.

name: call_then_halt_forever
description: Makes one call to another routine, then loops forever with no exit, so execution never returns from this point.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Does nothing and returns without touching any state; the listing reports more instructions than the decompiled body shows, so no behaviour can be recovered.

name: copy_selected_source_words
description: Chooses a source pointer from the flag bits of its register argument, then copies thirty-two words from it into the destination table, reading every second word of the source and filling the table from its end.

name: return_input_byte_unchanged
description: Returns the low byte of its argument unchanged, with no other effect.

name: return_input_byte_unchanged
description: Returns the low byte of its argument unchanged, with no other effect.

name: call_routine_with_one
description: Calls another routine with the constant one as its argument and returns.

name: call_routine_with_zero
description: Calls another routine with the constant zero as its argument and returns.

name: write_derived_word_to_table
description: Computes a table index from a global value minus three, then stores its word argument, multiplied by 256 and offset by a fixed constant, into the table entry at that index.

name: repeat_call_with_global_value
description: Makes one call, then calls another routine with a stored global value once for each count in its parameter, then makes one final call.

name: scan_table_for_marker_indices
description: Clears eight index globals, then scans a word table up to a terminator, recording the position of the marker value 384 and of the marker value 224 into the first free index slot for each.

name: advance_seeded_value_and_check
description: Starts a 16-bit value at 101 and applies a multiply-and-add step once per count held in a global, then returns the quotient of the value divided by 625 together with a flag saying whether its remainder equals a second global.

name: delay_and_set_ciab_port
description: Runs three short busy-wait loops and rewrites the CIA B port B register, forcing and keeping bits through a mask, with the delay loops before and after the write.

name: confirm_quit_request
description: When two table entries and an input flag indicate a quit request, displays the quit game y-or-n prompt, reads key presses until the answer is N or Y, and returns a table value.

name: delay_and_reset_cia_ports
description: Writes a fixed value to CIA B port B, runs a long busy-wait delay, clears bits of the CIA A direction register, then returns a value depending on whether bit three of a global status byte is clear.

name: store_two_helper_results
description: Calls a routine with two zero arguments and stores its result in a global, then calls the routine again with that result and stores the second result in another global.

name: read_trackdisk_block
description: Builds an I/O request for trackdisk.device with a read command of 1024 bytes into the buffer it receives, sends it through the exec library, then sends a follow-up command and a final request.

name: write_trackdisk_block
description: Builds an I/O request for trackdisk.device with a write command of 1024 bytes from the buffer it receives, sends it, then sends an update command and a clear command before a final request.

name: compute_data_checksum
description: Adds and XORs 249 bytes of a buffer, starting from fixed seed values, then either compares the two resulting checksum bytes with the two bytes after the buffer and returns zero on a match, or writes them there.

name: compute_word_sum_complement
description: Clears the second word of a 256-word block, sums all 256 words with end-around carry into a 32-bit accumulator, then stores the bitwise complement of the sum in the second word.

name: reset_machine_and_jump
description: Executes the processor reset instruction, then jumps through the fixed low-memory entry address used as the reset vector.

name: open_keyboard_device_request
description: Creates a message port and a 48-byte I/O request through library calls, then opens keyboard.device with that request, storing the request and port in globals.

name: setup_request_with_global_pointer
description: Writes a command value of ten, a length of thirteen and the address of a global buffer into a request structure, passes it to a library routine, then calls one more routine.

name: decode_key_state_buffer
description: Compares a block of key-state bytes with their previous copies, finds bits that newly changed, and for each one stores the index of the changed key into a global state table. The referenced text is a row of keyboard characters used for key names.

name: poll_title_input_with_timeout
description: Draws the title graphic and a question-mark graphic, then polls input for up to 220 iterations, returning a status from the input result, or zero if nothing arrives in time.

name: call_routines_over_range
description: Calls a routine for the first value with the constant one, for the end of the range computed as the sum minus one with one, then twice with both values, and returns.

name: find_last_passing_row
description: Scans rows of a table from the last to the first, calling a routine to test each row against a computed key and recording the last row that passes. If a row was recorded and the flag is clear it calls a routine, then makes further calls.

name: run_item_selection_loop
description: Builds a list of up to eight entries in a local array from a menu table, then runs a loop that polls for input events and moves through the entries. The visible code shows the setup and loop conditions; the input handling is only partly shown.

name: run_player_setup_menu
description: Shows the player setup menu with its text strings, toggling the player count between one and two when the selection is 1, and returns one when the done option, numbered 4, is chosen or zero when the menu is cancelled.

name: display_main_menu
description: Draws the control menu with labels for load, save, reset, selecting player one or two, and done, then loops handling the selection and returns the result.

name: initialize_key_flags_table
description: Clears a 128-byte buffer, marks the seven key codes in a string as set, then passes each of seventy-seven table entries and its index to a routine before finishing with a sentinel.

name: dispatch_table_entries
description: Reads a table entry selected by an index, then makes a series of routine calls at offsets from that entry, adding extra calls when the case value is ten, and finally writes the entry's byte in shifted form.

name: load_production_graphics
description: Loads a long list of compressed graphics files for the production screen and sets display parameters. The referenced text includes a new production record message and a cheat mode message.

name: display_credits_screen
description: Draws the credits screen, with the design, coding, graphics, music and copyright lines as referenced text, using display routines in sequence, and selects between two graphics based on a flag.

name: draw_production_records_table
description: Draws the production records header, then loops over rows of twenty-byte records, writing each row's number as a digit and each record's fields with routine calls.

name: shift_word_and_call_pair
description: Copies one word, found at an offset from one address register plus an index, into the word just before that address, then calls a routine and another routine with two 16-bit arguments.

name: call_two_subroutines
description: Calls one routine with no arguments, then calls another with two 16-bit values taken from its parameters.

name: forward_call_to_routine
description: Calls another routine with no arguments and returns, acting as a simple pass-through.

name: call_routine_sequence_with_zeros
description: Calls one routine without arguments, then a second and third with the constant zero, then a fourth without arguments, and returns.

name: forward_call_to_routine
description: Calls another routine with no arguments and returns, acting as a simple pass-through.

name: display_intro_credits
description: Loads the intro graphics for the developer logo and character portraits and sets display parameters, with the word presents in its referenced text, then calls a sequence of display routines that drive the opening presentation.

name: display_title_screen
description: Shows the title screen graphic and a loading message, sets up the display, and calls the title and display routines in order. With a non-zero argument it runs one extra step.

name: match_typed_key_sequence
description: Reads a key code and returns zero when no key is pressed. A special code either latches a value or toggles a flag; any other key is compared with the next character of a stored string, advancing the match position, and once the whole string matches it shows the credit lines listed in its referenced text.

name: process_input_flags
description: Calls a routine with the global state, and calls a routine when bit two of its flag argument is clear. When bit zero is set it calls three routines with fixed arguments, and its remaining flag handling loops on a routine until that returns a non-zero value.

name: any_record_flag_set
description: Walks entries of ten bytes up to a count, returning true as soon as one has bit four set. If none does, it returns the state of bit four in a final global record.

name: display_character_roster_screen
description: Loads the portraits for Fiona, Fred, Larry and Lemmy and draws the names Cliff Lemming, Frank Foreman, Jodee Lemming and Larry Lawyer from its referenced text, then runs the display steps.

name: display_get_ready_screen
description: Loads office and character graphics and shows the get-ready text for player one or player two, chosen by a global flag, then calls routines to configure the display.

name: decode_quinary_state
description: Splits a number into four base-five digits held in a local array, calls routines that update global state from those digits, and returns a value.

name: display_shift_financial_summary
description: Draws the shift summary with wages, bonus and deduction lines, computing amounts from a global table, reports cheat mode messages, and asks the continue game y-or-n question when the shift is incomplete.

name: display_shift_bonus_breakdown
description: Draws a bonus breakdown with packing, wages, bonus and deduction text, formatting dollar amounts in a 40-byte text buffer. The bonus lines appear only when a shift counter exceeds twelve.

name: display_game_over_screen
description: Draws the game over background, selects the player one or player two result graphics and labels from a global flag, and displays them with routine calls.

name: draw_entry_table_items
description: Iterates over a global table of entries, calling routines with positions offset from the parameter for each one and stepping a value by twenty-seven per entry. The visible code shows drawing-style calls but not the full logic.

name: run_fixit_form_selection
description: Draws the form for Fiona Fixit or Fred Fixit from the form graphics, then loops over seven entries checking input flags and updating a selection value.

name: run_orders_screen_until_key
description: Draws the orders screen background and the press F1 to return message, then loops reading input until a particular key code arrives, calling routines on each pass.

name: map_shift_count_to_offset
description: Maps a shift count to a table offset: 1 to 0, 5 to 7, 11 to 14, 17 to 21, 23 to 28 and 29 to 35, then draws the game over text using that offset.

name: build_indexed_entry_list
description: Looks up a value in a global table by index and passes it to a routine, then loops over the bytes of a record, building a list of entries through routine calls into local buffers.

name: call_with_word_then_routine
description: Calls a routine with the low word of its parameter, then calls a second routine with no arguments.

name: call_two_routines_in_order
description: Calls two routines in order with no arguments and returns.

name: convert_word_to_ascii
description: Writes the tens and units digits of a 16-bit value as ASCII characters into a buffer and appends a null terminator. The tens digit is the quotient by ten, so values above ninety-nine give non-digit characters.

name: poll_global_flag_loop
description: Repeatedly calls a routine with a global variable and, while bit four of its result is set, calls a second routine and polls again.

name: check_sprite_buffer_overflow
description: Computes the offset between its parameter and a global base, and when that offset exceeds 47299 calls the routine that reports the sprite buffer has overflowed.

name: clip_and_blit_rectangle
description: Waits for the blitter to be idle, then checks whether a rectangle lies inside a clip window and, when it overlaps, programs the blitter masks and modulo registers for a copy. The remainder of the routine was not fully recovered.

name: wait_and_store_struct_fields
description: Waits until a busy flag in a structure clears, then stores two register values and a word into fixed fields of that structure.

name: configure_blitter_copy
description: Waits for the blitter to be idle, then sets its channel pointers, modulo, size and mask registers from the two parameters, deriving the source address from a computed offset and the destination from a global base.

name: configure_blitter_source_and_size
description: Waits for the blitter to be idle, then sets its mask, modulo, pointer and size registers from a computed offset and the parameters. The rest of the routine was not fully recovered.

name: forward_two_arguments
description: Passes its two 16-bit arguments unchanged to another routine and returns.

name: clip_region_and_blit
description: Clips a rectangle against bounds, adjusting its position and size, and returns early when nothing remains. Otherwise it programs the blitter with the remaining size and masks.

name: wait_flag_and_store_data
description: Waits until bit six of a status byte in a structure is clear, then stores a register value into two fields, and a word read through a pointer plus a word value into a third field.

name: run_blitter_copy_passes
description: Waits for the blitter to be idle, programs its source, destination, mask and modulo registers, then loops eight times waiting for the blitter and setting its width register, with each pass recomputed from a global.

name: setup_blitter_copy_from_record
description: Waits for the blitter to be idle, programs its masks, modulo, pointer and size registers from fields of a record, and returns the computed destination address.

name: setup_blitter_block_transfer
description: Calculates the block width, row length and pointers from two parameters, stores them in a record, then waits for the blitter and programs its registers for the transfer.

name: decode_timed_out_routine
description: The decompiler timed out, so no logic could be recovered. The listing shows only a fifteen-instruction routine that twenty-one other routines call.

name: calculate_string_weight
description: Walks a zero-terminated string and sums a value per character: when a global flag is zero it adds a per-character increment from a global, otherwise it adds an entry from a lookup table indexed by each character code, and returns the total.

name: call_twice_with_two_words
description: Calls one routine with no arguments, then calls it again with the low words of its two parameters.

name: iterate_string_bytes
description: Walks a zero-terminated string and calls a routine for each character, passing a global value, the table base and the parameter.

name: setup_fixed_blitter_sprite
description: Waits for the blitter, programs its masks, modulo, pointer and size registers with fixed values and addresses derived from two parameters, then calls two routines.

name: shift_bitplane_data
description: Shifts a block of 16-bit words right by one bit, carrying the low bit of each word into the top bit of the next, and repeats the shift for a fixed number of passes per block.

name: initialize_game_state_tables
description: Writes default counter values and fills tables through a series of initialisation routine calls, mostly calls and constant writes in the visible code.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Does nothing and returns immediately; the decompiled body is empty, so no behaviour can be recovered.

name: clamp_vertical_scroll
description: Adjusts a global vertical scroll offset from its parameter with a hysteresis window, then clamps the result between zero and 633.

name: build_row_record_index
description: Fills a table of 802 entries, one per row, with the index of the current record as the scan advances through 24-byte records, stopping at a record whose value exceeds 999.

name: fetch_table_entry
description: Computes an address from the upper word of its argument, scaled by eight within a global table, and calls a routine with that address and a second routine's address.
